library_binding_scope: Current workspace build only; this is not proof that any historical/future run loaded these bytes. Future run closure must bind loaded plugin independently.

derivation.admissible_base_speed_mps: 0.32 < base_speed < 1.35 per retained config validator; initial_speed >= 0
derivation.step_rule: next_speed=current+clamp(target-current,-deceleration*dt,acceleration*dt), so bounded by max(current,target); progress trapezoidal integral has the same average-speed envelope
derivation.new_gate: advanceAstraGatedActor delegates unchanged to advanceV3ReactiveActor using active_dt=max(0, now-max(previous,activation)); this is no greater than the elapsed step. No progress before gate; endpoint clamp/fault cannot increase commanded progress.
derivation.fixed_heading: yaw of end-start; observed heading changes remain pending without angular bound
derivation.not_a_continuous_bound: SetWorldPose has discrete jumps and both plugins reset published linear/angular velocity to zero. The formula remains conditional; known filename is not a continuous-safety qualification.

changes: Support exact libastra_reactive_actor_plugin.so as well as retained libv3_reactive_actor_plugin.so, with per-actor descriptor/target values in evaluation JSON.
Check actual new actor required paths/route gate fields and runtime rejection conditions; reject unsupported or multiple model plugins.
When actor roster/bounds are incomplete, combined point-speed and conditional swept bound are null instead of a finite partial sum.
Keep raw source-pose jump check, continuous pending, fully_safety_qualified_success=false, and failure-inclusive qualified time22s.
